Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You study the current, choose your line, and slip into the river without surrendering your bearings.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
A swim you could ordinarily attempt
Duration
Information and earned progress persist for the stated task; completed changes remain until circumstances alter them.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Pay the printed action and any full activity time for each use.
Type
Skill / Utility

Choose a swim that you could ordinarily attempt. Before a consequential attempt, the DA states how much progress is needed to complete it. Roll Brawn. This card does not let you breathe underwater.

Weak
Add 1 progress toward completing the swim and keep one carried item dry.
Standard
Add 2 progress, keep that item dry and keep your bearings in the current.
Strong
Add 3 progress and gain both benefits above; also identify a safer nearby landing, if one is available.
